notes.title: Announcing Ver.1.03
notes.content:
I'm Kajinoyu.

Ver.1.03 releases April 20th, 2025.

[h1]Ver.1.03 Patch Notes[/h1]
[h3]■Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Revised onigiri score handling in Stage 1 (onigiri reset after clearing the tutorial for the second time or later)
[/list]
